mapper.select: SELECT /* @SQLID=SUB0504_02-01#SQL001 */ COUNT(1) FROM MEDIATE_USER_ATTRIBUTE_INFO MUAI WHERE MUAI.BUTEN_CODE = #{butenCode} AND MUAI.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = TO_NUMBER(#{accountNumber})

insert.foreach: MERGE /* @SQLID=SUB0504_02-01#SQL002 */ INTO T_IPO_PO_EDELIV_AGRMNT A USING ( SELECT #{req.butenCode} AS BUTEN_CODE, TO_NUMBER(#{req.accountNumber}) AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER FROM DUAL ) B ON ( A.BUTEN_CODE = B.BUTEN_CODE AND A.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = B.ACCOUNT_NUMBER ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.EDELIV_AGREEMENT_DATE = CASE WHEN #{req.edelivAgreementKbn} = '1' AND #{req.edelivAgreementDate} IS NOT NULL AND #{req.edelivAgreementDate} != '' AND #{req.edelivAgreementDate} != '-' THEN TO_DATE(#{req.edelivAgreementDate}, 'YYYY/MM/DD') ELSE NULL END, A.EDELIV_AGREEMENT_KBN = #{req.edelivAgreementKbn}, A.UPDATE_TIME = IFA_DATE_UTIL.IFA_GET_DATE, A.UPDATE_USER = #{req.userId}, A.SYS_ID = 'SUB0504' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( BUTEN_CODE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, EDELIV_AGREEMENT_DATE, EDELIV_AGREEMENT_KBN, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, SYS_ID ) VALUES ( #{req.butenCode}, TO_NUMBER(#{req.accountNumber}), CASE WHEN #{req.edelivAgreementKbn} = '1' AND #{req.edelivAgreementDate} IS NOT NULL AND #{req.edelivAgreementDate} != '' AND #{req.edelivAgreementDate} != '-' THEN TO_DATE(#{req.edelivAgreementDate}, 'YYYY/MM/DD') ELSE NULL END, #{req.edelivAgreementKbn}, IFA_DATE_UTIL.IFA_GET_DATE, #{req.userId}, IFA_DATE_UTIL.IFA_GET_DATE, #{req.userId}, 'SUB0504' )
